description: Use when an agent must vet a South Korean supplier or counterparty before paying, contracting or onboarding it. Input: one of business_number, dart_corp_code, stock_code or q (exact company name). Output: JSON summary (riskLevel, riskFlags such as closed/suspended or sanctions match, per-section status) plus NTS status, DART profile, 12-month KONEPS award summary and OFAC/EU/UK screening of the English name. Not a legal determination. Example: ?stock_code=005930 Price: $0.015 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

q.description: Company name (Korean or English), matched exactly after removing legal-form words

name: kr_supplier_check
title: Korea company KYB / Korean supplier check: identity, NTS business status, DART profile, public-procurement record and sanctions in one call
